summary: LeBron James played his first preseason game for Philadelphia, but Brooklyn's 37-point third quarter decided it. AJ Dybantsa debuted in Washington's 111-109 win at Madison Square Garden, and Atlanta came back from 23 down to win in San Antonio. Giannis Antetokounmpo needed only 18 minutes to lead Miami, Boston's reserves beat Cleveland, and the Lakers held off a 40-point Kings fourth quarter.

games.headline: Garza and Boston's bench outlast Cleveland
games.story: With Jayson Tatum, Paul George, Derrick White, Payton Pritchard and Sam Hauser all held out, Boston's reserves carried the night. Luka Garza had 22 points, 10 rebounds and 3 blocks. Cleveland used a 12-0 run early in the third quarter to tie it at 74, but the Celtics opened the fourth with an 11-3 run and led by as many as 15. James Harden did not play.

games.headline: Brooklyn's 37-point third spoils LeBron's Sixers debut
games.story: LeBron James played 18 minutes in his first preseason game as a Sixer and finished with 10 points and 5 assists, 8 of the points at the line. Philadelphia led 58-56 at the half before Brooklyn won the third quarter 37-23. The Sixers cut it to one with 1:14 left, and the Nets closed on a 5-0 run. Joel Embiid had 8 turnovers in 24 minutes.

games.headline: Giannis needs 18 minutes, then Miami pulls away
games.story: Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 18 on 8-of-13 shooting in 18 minutes, and Myron Gardner added 11 points, 4 rebounds, 4 assists and 3 steals off the bench. New Orleans erased a 9-point halftime deficit, and the game was tied at 107 with under seven minutes left. Miami then outscored the Pelicans 21-11 the rest of the way. The Heat were without Keshad Johnson, Dru Smith and Pelle Larsson; Dejounte Murray sat for New Orleans.

games.headline: Dybantsa debuts as Washington rallies at the Garden
games.story: AJ Dybantsa made his preseason debut with 11 points and four steals, and Anthony Davis led Washington with 16. The Knicks led by 10 late in the third quarter, but the Wizards took the lead for good with 7:26 left and pushed it to nine. New York scored the last seven points and ran out of time.

games.headline: Hawks erase a 23-point hole in San Antonio
games.story: The Spurs led 45-22 early in the second quarter before Atlanta answered with a 20-5 run. After a back-and-forth stretch midway through the fourth, the Hawks pulled away with a 13-0 run. Kingston Flemings had 15 points, 5 assists and 3 steals, and Asa Newell scored 16 in 14 minutes. Victor Wembanyama played 17 minutes; De'Aaron Fox and Jalen Johnson did not play.

games.headline: Lakers hold off a 40-point Kings fourth
games.story: Sandro Mamukelashvili and Luka Doncic combined for 42 points through three quarters as the Lakers built an 86-70 lead. Sacramento won the fourth quarter 40-28 but finished four points short. The Kings were without Domantas Sabonis, Malik Monk, Keegan Murray and Ben Simmons.
